newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLISH BENSON AND HEDGES CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLISH BENSON AND HEDGES CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results of Benson and Hedges Cup
Leeds (Headingley): Yorkshire beat Minor Counties by 184 runs. Yorkshire 309-5 innings closed (A.McGrath 109 not out, D.Byas 72), Minor Counties 125 (S.Dean 56).

Manchester (Old Trafford): Lancashire beat Worcestershire by losing less wickets. Lancashire 274-6 innings closed (N.Fairbrother 75 not out, J.Gallian 59), Worcestershire 274-8 innings closed (T.Moody 92)
Northampton: Northamptonshire beat Leicestershire by 52 runs. Northamptonshire 238-8 innings closed, Leicestershire 186-8 innings closed (N.Johnson 58; J.Snape 5-32)
London (The Oval): Surrey beat Sussex by 11 runs. Surrey 310-8 innings closed (G.Thorpe 78, A.Stewart 72; P.Jarvis 4-60), Sussex 299 (N.Taylor 67, R.Rao 61, M.Newell 60; I.Salisbury 4-53).
Oxford (The Parks): Hampshire beat British Universities by seven wickets. British Universities 284-8 innings closed (T.Hodgson 113, U.Rashid 82), Hampshire 287-3 (M.Hayden 120 not out, G.White 56).
London (Lord's): Somerset 172-4 (P.Bowler 54 not out, M.Burns 54) v Middlesex
